questions.solution:
We know that:

a3 + b3 = (a + b) (a2 + b2 - ab)

8p3 + 125q3

= (2p)3 + (5q)3

= (2p + 5q) [(2p)2 + (5q)2 - 2p * 5q]

= (2p + 5q) (4p2 + 25q2 - 10pq)

Hence, (2p + 5q) and (4p2 + 25q2 - 10pq) are the required factors.

Only option (b) is TRUE.
